subject: Cross-region demo: Novum Health / Redwood - scheduling & timezone options

Subject: Cross-region demo: Novum Health / Redwood - scheduling & timezone options

Hi Olivia -

Great to meet you on the call last week. We'd love to run a 45-minute walkthrough of Redwood focused on low-latency inference for clinical summarization and how our Dedicated offering can help control costs.

I wanted to propose a few cross-region slots that should work for our EU-based engineering leads (they're in Amsterdam) while still being reasonable for your US East team:

- Tue Mar 10 - 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 18:00 CET
- Wed Mar 11 - 07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 16:30 CET
- Thu Mar 12 - 06:00 PT / 09:00 ET / 15:00 CET (early, but doable)

If none of those work, we can do an evening slot (after 19:00 ET) with a smaller EU subset.

I've attached a short draft agenda and a link to a Calendly page with more slots: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/novum-demo

Thanks - let me know which of the above you'd prefer and I can send a calendar invitation.

Best,
Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0172

Of the times you proposed, Wednesday Mar 11 at 10:30 ET is probably the best for the majority. The team would prefer no earlier than 10:30 ET. Can the demo include a 10-15 minute deep dive on security/compliance (SOC 2 + data residency)?

16:30 CET on Wed Mar 11 works for me. I'll plan to cover the runtime architecture and demo a streaming trace so you can see latency and KV caching behavior. Laura - can you join for the compliance portion (10-15 minutes) and be prepared to cover SOC 2 controls and our private deployment options?

A couple quick coordination notes:
- Because this is crossing US/EU, I suggest we keep the main demo to 35 minutes and reserve the last 10 for security and Q&A. That'll help keep the meeting within business hours for everyone.
- If anyone on Novum absolutely needs a later ET time (after 19:00 ET) we can run a lean session with just the SE and PM.

Thanks,
Rishi

rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
